title: A six-hour connection-refused outage on the budget acquirer
description: Spike-local scenario for #7's transport-error labeling question. outage-recovery-v1 expresses a connection_refused outage but only for 600 s (~120 transactions at benchmark scale): too short for the posterior to react, so the labeling choice cannot be measured there. This document extends baseline-steady-v1 with one long refusal -- six hours, the 'the PSP is down and its status page is yellow' case -- followed by a step recovery. It is a real scenario document: it resolves against baseline-steady-v1, passes the same gate (SV0-SV10), and hashes like any other; it lives in the spike because it is evidence for #7, not a fixture for #17.
